decision_summary: QIF v0.6.38 is approved for release with immutable-history and illustrative-evidence boundaries explicit.
rationale: Schema, example, verifier, 30 new negative fixtures, plain-language documentation, roadmap, and runtime evidence align; policy changes reproduce, stale decisions trigger review, historical authority is preserved, and all structural tests pass.
recommendation: Commit, tag, push, and publish v0.6.38; then begin v0.6.39 Adjudication Feedback and Rubric Revision.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, accountable reviewers, domain specialists, operators, and affected stakeholders
expected_user_reaction: Users can see which policy governed a decision, what changed, why revalidation was required, and what remains uncertain.
